name: Xperia Z5 Compact

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia Z3 Compact (Global), Sony Xperia A4 (Japan)

Body.Dimensions: 127 mm H , 65 mm W , 8.9 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 5.1.1 Lollipop Upgradable to Android 7.1.1 Nougat
Platform.CPU: Quad-core 1.5 GHz Cortex-A53 & Quad-core 2.0 GHz Cortex-A57 (2.0 GHz Qualcomm MSM8994 Octa Core)

Display.Display: 4.6 in 720p IPS LCD, HD 1280x720 px, TRILUMINOS™ Display with Live Color LED, X-Reality Engine for Mobile , Dynamic Contrast Enhancer

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou, NFC, Bluetooth 4.1, MHL 3.0, USB 2.0 (Micro-B port, USB charging, Quick Charge 2.0), USB OTG, 3.50 mm headphone jack, 5 pole, fingerprint sensor
